claimed_invariant: A Java `note [right|left|top|bottom] (on|of) link [color]` command is relationship-owned state, not an anonymous diagram note. It attaches to the last ordinary Link, defaults to BOTTOM, and a later command replaces the link's prior note. SvekEdge composes the resulting note block with the center-label block according to position: LEFT/RIGHT horizontally and TOP/BOTTOM vertically. The composed natural dimensions enter Graphviz and the same composition determines painting and painted bounds. Single-line and multiline commands share these semantics.
causal_divergence: Rust recognizes only three exact lowercase `note on link` spellings, stores the result as a targetless generic Note with no position, and later guesses the owner from source-line order. Positioned and `of link` forms are not parsed, while relationship_note_indices explicitly rejects generic notes whose position is set. The preserved painted_04 and painted_05 inputs therefore omit the note before the painted-frontier mechanism can be evaluated. Generic-note ownership also cannot faithfully represent replacement, default-bottom semantics, or the four Java block compositions.
planned_model_change: Add an optional relationship-owned ClassLinkNote carrying lines, color, position, and source line. Parse Java's single-line and multiline grammar with optional position and `on|of`, default omitted position to Bottom, attach to the last ordinary relationship, and replace an earlier link note. Keep a dedicated multiline accumulator so generic standalone-note state cannot steal ownership. Compose note and label blocks by position for preferred dimensions, painting, and painted bounds. Preserve terminal parse errors for Java-shaped malformed link-note commands instead of silently converting them to generic text.
perturbation_axes: default bottom versus explicit top, bottom, left, and right
label-only, note-only, and combined label-plus-note relationships
note color, repeated replacement, and intervening standalone notes
renamed classes, labels, and note text
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns class link-note parsing, relationship ownership, replacement, position, and block composition. It does not own link-note font inheritance, Creole atom alignment, the generic standalone-note model, route synthesis, comparator behavior, baselines, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: Parser tests cover on/of, all positions, default bottom, color, replacement, multiline input, no prior link, malformed suffix, bad color, and empty multiline body.
Fresh valid inputs prove all four compositions use the same relationship-owned note for Graphviz dimensions, painting, and painted bounds.
Intervening standalone or attached notes do not change the last ordinary relationship owner.
An independent checker audits the Java and Rust ownership model, generates held-outs over at least two axes, and records a verdict at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: inferring link-note ownership from fixture text or expected coordinates
treating top and bottom as render-only offsets while leaving natural dimensions unchanged
changing route geometry, comparator tolerance, baselines, skips, or fixture eligibility
